answer.title: Automate Invoice Creation on Job Completion
answer.trigger: A job is marked as complete in the jobs system.
steps: Detect when a job status changes to complete in the jobs system.
Extract job details and customer information from the completed job.
Draft a new invoice with the correct line items and amounts in the accounts system.
Send the drafted invoice to Emma for review and approval.
answer.ai_help: Extracting job details and drafting the correct invoice lines in the accounts system.
answer.human_approval: Emma must review and approve the draft invoice before it is finalized and sent to the customer.
answer.risk_reason: If the automation makes a mistake, incorrect invoices could be sent to customers, leading to payment disputes or lost revenue.
